map.输入多组 x,y 数据点（每行一个，用逗号或空格分隔），用最小二乘法计算线性回归: Enter multiple (x,y) data points (one per line, separated by comma or space); compute the least-squares linear-regression equation y=ax+b and the correlation coefficient R².
map.基于最小二乘线性回归，对 n 组 (x,y) 求斜率 a，配合截距 b 得到拟合: Based on least-squares linear regression, for n (x,y) points it finds slope a and intercept b to produce the fitted line y=a·x+b, used for trend prediction and correlation analysis.
map.💡 最小二乘法：斜率 a = (n·Σxy − Σx·Σy) ÷ (n·Σx²: 💡 Least squares: slope a = (n·Σxy − Σx·Σy) ÷ (n·Σx² − (Σx)²); intercept b = (Σy − a·Σx) ÷ n; correlation coefficient R² = [ (n·Σxy − Σx·Σy) ]² ÷ [ (n·Σx² − (Σx)²) · (n·Σy² − (Σy)²) ].
map.至少需要 2 组有效数据点才能拟合: At least 2 valid data points are required to fit a line
map.每行格式：x,y（逗号、空格或制表符分隔）: Format per line: x,y (separated by comma, space or tab)
map.R² 越接近1表示线性相关性越强: R² closer to 1 indicates stronger linear correlation
map.📚 深度解析：线性回归（最小二乘法）计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Linear Regression (Least Squares) Calculation
map.趋势拟合：对一组 (x,y) 数据点求最佳拟合直线与斜率: Trend fitting: find the best-fit line and slope for a set of (x,y) data points
map.r 衡量线性关系密切程度: r measures the strength of the linear relationship
map.预测外推：代入 x 用拟合直线预测 y: Prediction / extrapolation: plug in x to predict y with the fitted line
map.最小二乘：斜率 b=(n·Σxy−Σx·Σy)÷(n·Σx²−(Σx)²)，截距: Least squares: slope b=(n·Σxy−Σx·Σy)÷(n·Σx²−(Σx)²), intercept a=(Σy−b·Σx)÷n; correlation coefficient r=(n·Σxy−Σx·Σy)÷√[(n·Σx²−(Σx)²)(n·Σy²−(Σy)²)]; the closer |r| is to 1, the stronger the linearity.
map.r 为 0.9 表示强正相关，x 增大 y 明显增大；但相关不等于因果，且外推到: r=0.9 indicates a strong positive correlation — y clearly increases as x grows; but correlation is not causation, and extrapolating to x far outside the sample range enlarges prediction error.
map.最少需要几个点？: What is the minimum number of points?
map.至少 2 个点才能定一条直线，但 n 过小拟合不可靠、r 易虚高；建议样本足够且: At least 2 points are needed to define a line, but a very small n makes the fit unreliable and r artificially high; use a sufficient sample and check an approximate linear scatter plot before fitting.
map.线性回归计算器采用最小二乘法，对输入的 x,y 数据点进行一元线性拟合，输出回归: The linear-regression calculator uses least squares to fit a univariate line to the input (x,y) data points, outputting the regression equation y=ax+b, the coefficient of determination R², the correlation coefficient r and the root-mean-square error; it suits data-trend analysis and statistics learning.
